title: The **Prime-Encoded Quantum Biological Network Algorithm** introduces prime numbers into the modeling of quantum biological networks. Biological systems, such as photosynthesis, DNA replication, and cell signaling, often exhibit quantum behaviors, such as coherence, tunneling, and entanglement, that contribute to their efficiency. By embedding prime numbers into the interactions between quantum particles in these networks, this algorithm could provide novel insights into how quantum coherence and prime number modulation influence biological functions and processes.
